turns.instruction:
Build the three-storey single-bay frame from the attachment. Keep D, W+ and W- as independent signed cases, and evaluate the three explicitly listed combinations D, D+W+ and D+W-. D includes an additional downward 5 kN/m on the left half of the second-storey beam, in addition to its baseline 10 kN/m. Distinguish case D from combination D in labels. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Increase only the magnitude of each W- storey force by 20 percent, retaining its negative global-X direction. The new W- forces from bottom to top are -12, -18 and -24 kN. Preserve W+, D (including the second-storey partial UDL), geometry, sections and all combination factors. Rerun the current state. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
